summary: Minimal, correct fix that swaps the reversed `top`/`bottom` alignment cases in `_get_aligned_offsets`; `left`/`right` mappings and thus VPacker behavior are untouched, so only the buggy HPacker vertical alignment is corrected.

issues.description: Corrects a user-visible behavior: any code that compensated for the reversed HPacker `top`/`bottom` will now flip. Legitimate bug fix, but worth a changelog/release-note mention.
No comment added explaining that this shared helper maps left/bottom vs right/top for the two packer orientations; a brief note would prevent future re-swap regressions.
